reviews.t: Cuts hairs, and super stiff
reviews.x: These are actually pretty horrible. The reviews were so good, so I'm surprised. They are SO stiff-- it takes so much effort to bring the tips together (aka the point of tweezers). They also don't grip well. They seem to consistently cut the hair, rather than clamp down on it so you can pull. Also, the pointy ones are so dull! The tip is too thick to get to anything delicate (like a splinter).

reviews.t: Cuts hairs instead of tweezing, leaving stubble.
reviews.x: I'm really confused how anyone can use these? I can't get them to pull hairs, they just snip them off like a tiny pair of scissors. What good does that do? I have never had that problem with the cheap ones I have been always using before. I even tried it with a long hair from my head just so I could see what it was doing, and it just snips no matter how gently I do it. Waste of my money.

reviews.t: Good, but could use improvement...
reviews.x: These tweezers were a good buy for the price. I was pleased that one of the set is pink as I love pink and would like every item in pink. An issue with the tweezers for me were that they have no grip and are too smooth for handling tough plucking without one. My fingers kept sliding off. Another is that the slanted edge one actually cut some hairs while I was plucking, making them too short to remove properly. If not for these problems, I would give them a five star rating.

reviews.t: ♡Love, Love, Love it!♡
reviews.x: This set is so cute and so nice. It even says, "Love it" on the tweezers, because it is definitely a set worth loving. This is definitely going to help with my eyebrows and all my tweezing needs. It comes in a nice case too, inorder to keep them oraganized. I am so glad I bought this. I even received a chance to win a $50 gift card, for Amazon, in the package. I want to see more products by this company because I am sure I will love them, as well.

reviews.t: Great set I love the variety of colors
reviews.x: Great set I love the variety of colors. It even comes with its own case. Very easy to use and gets the job done fast. I love these and so does my family I use these to pluck eyebrows, my husband to pick splinters from hands and its great to clean my kids nails. I would highly reccomend this item. High durable material doesn't bend easily. Overall great product. I got the best opportunity to review this in return for my HONEST review.

reviews.t: My Wife Says They Are The Best She Has Ever Used!
reviews.x: I gotta tell ya, my Wife received the tweezers and she went right to work with them on her eyebrows (since she lost her previous pair). She said, "These are by far the best tweezers I have ever used! They are amazing!"  So thank you for making this deal on these tweezers available and for many years to come, may the tweezing continue on.

reviews.t: Bad quality tweezers (how did this set get so many stars)?
reviews.x: Bad quality! Not sure why so many good reviews. Here is the set I received today. Non of the arms are matched or line up, the ends don't meet flush, only one set works at gripping, but the edge that allows it to grip is so small it will wear off fast. I am returning for refund (I should have spent the money and bought tweezerman)!

reviews.t: Get All those Little Hairs With These Tweezers!
reviews.x: Love these tweezers. They arrived quickly in a little black box which I opened to find a black leather pouch containing 3 different tweezers. They fit perfectly in my purse and ttake care of all my beauty needs including removing tiny splinters from my fingers. The price was perfect and customer service was amazing.

reviews.t: These tweezers work every bit as good as the more expensive brands
reviews.x: These tweezers work every bit as good as the more expensive brands!  Plus they come in this neat little black pouch so easy to keep and find when needed!  I have been using them for a couple weeks now and am considering buying some more for gifts.  Go ahead and give them a try! You will not be disappointed.

reviews.t: Great for precision plucking!
reviews.x: Great for precision plucking! Arrived on time, super fast and I used immediately. Nice presentation as well. The kit came in a nice box and case. It would serve as a great "stocking stuffer" for the upcoming holidays. I am very happy with the tweezers, they are very sharp and I highly recommend it.

reviews.t: Complete garbage
reviews.x: Terrible product. The black and pink tweezers don't actually grab anything; they snip and you will end up with little hairs and/or ingrown hairs. The silver ones don't come together at the point where they should so you can't grab anything. I'm trying to figure out if I can return these!!

reviews.t: the only one I do not like is the non angled one
reviews.x: I have used them a few times now and 2 of the 3 tweezers work very well; the only one I do not like is the non angled one. Perhaps it is human error but I can't seem to get it to remove any hair. Overall I am very pleased with this purchase, you can't beat 3 pairs for the price of 1.

reviews.t: they make their product with lots of love and care involved
reviews.x: Amazing product, better than expected, nice finishing by precise metal cuts, you can get any thin hair or fiber with these tweezers. On the other hand, the people running the business are excellent and one can notice they make their product with lots of love and care involved ,

reviews.t: Love my new Tweezers
reviews.x: Love these new tweezers. Good grip for brows and picking up small objects. The pointed end one is good for ingrown hairs. The cute leather carrying case help you get from having to dump out you manicure bag looking for your tweezers. I'm ding 101 new uses for my tweezers.

reviews.t: The best tweezer trio! Highly recommend!
reviews.x: Love, love, love this set of tweezers and case. Having 3 different sizes in the same case makes the handy for any situation from plucking eyebrows to removing pesky splinters or ingrown hairs. This was a great purchase at a great price. Would definitely purchase again!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the three-piece set (flat, slanted, pointed) versatile and effective for different tweezing needs.
Several reviewers praise the build quality, describing the tweezers as sturdy, well made, and professional.
Some reviewers report the tweezers are too stiff and fail to grip, cutting hairs instead of pulling them out by the root.
Reviewers appreciate the included case/pouch for keeping the set organized and portable.
A few reviewers mention handling issues such as smooth surfaces causing fingers to slip.
